description: B1 (v0.4): labeled benchmark for evaluation-blend retrieval. Each query lists 1-3 ground-truth relevant skills out of the 50-skill fixture corpus. synthetic_meta lets us populate sparse mega_meta evidence (helpful/harmful counts + contexts) at benchmark time so the v0.3 blend has a signal to consume — only the few skills relevant to a given scenario carry non-trivial data; everything else stays cold (use_eval=False ordering is unchanged).
